name: core_test_access_networks
description: Ops core plan section 10 part 1: test_access_networks through the network routes, captured before any ops-core edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model networks

A test floor for networks (ACCESS_MODEL_SLICE_9_3_PLAN.md, slice 9.3a). Twelve beats, each with a sign. Take the drop box from the lobby table and plug it into the wall port in the comms room (north): its link item in your inventory shows what that network exposes. Sam's PC is in the desk room (east), with the kiosk, the store and the finance office off it. The workshop (west) has a second port on a second network. Three people in the lobby hold the accounts.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: run the twelve network beats.

contents.name: backup_readme.txt
contents.text: Backup vault on the server network. (N3: reached only by pivoting through an office session.)
contents.observations: A readme in the server network's backup share.

contents.name: scan_0412.pdf
contents.text:
Scanned letter, page 1 of 1.

Welcome to finance, Lena. Your account is ready.
Username: lfox
Starter password: Ledger-Lena-9

Please change it when you first sign in. (Nobody does.)
contents.observations: A scanned welcome letter, left in the scanner's inbox.

contents.name: IT handover.txt
contents.text:
IT handover, while Ian is on leave.

Door controller admin: ishaw / Patchday!2026
The year-end folder in this archive: PIN 2468

Delete this file after reading. (Nobody will.)
contents.observations: A handover note from IT, filed in the finance archive.

contents.name: Year-end
contents.observations: A PIN-locked folder of year-end figures.

contents.name: Year-end report.xlsx
contents.text: Year-end report: revenue up, costs up more. (P5: the locked folder opened.)

print_queue.name: Office print queue
print_queue.observations: A print queue anyone on the LAN can read: three payslips waiting for collection.

contents.name: guest_wifi.txt
contents.text: Guest Wi-Fi notice: this network reaches the internet only. (N8: the guest network was joined.)
contents.observations: A notice left on the guest network's little file share.

contents.name: bench_readme.txt
contents.text: Bench readme: the soldering station is on its own network. (P11: this share opened.)
contents.observations: A readme from the workshop's storage box.

objectives.title: Run the network beats
objectives.description: Test only. Each task ticks when its beat's event fires; the plant and the vault are checked by the server.

tasks.title: P1: open the open share from Sam's desktop
P2: plant the box in the comms room
P3: look at what the box reaches
P4: copy the letter from the open share
P5: sign in to Lena's PC through the box, then open the locked folder
P6: Switch user on Lena's remote desktop is refused for Sam
P7: sign in at the kiosk itself
P8: open the lobby vault with the code from the store's door controller
P9: open Lena's PC at her desk
P10: unplug the box from the comms room
P11: plant the box in the workshop and look
P12: after a reload, Lena's PC opens through the box with no password
N11: a dropped stick an NPC uses gives a foothold on the door controller's network
N12: a BadUSB at Sam's desk gives a foothold and is consumed
N13: the kiosk's USB policy refuses the BadUSB
N8: join the guest Wi-Fi with the key and look at what it reaches
N9: join again through the second guest access point
N2: after signing in to an office PC through the box, the server network appears
N3: sign in to the server host across the link
N4: sign out of the office pivot and the server session ends
N10: a secured port refuses the box and keeps it
N5: take the server network down; it leaves the box's view and a sign-in on it is refused
N6: restore the server network; its block fills in and its host signs in again
N7: a held server session survives the outage, shows no route, and reopens on repair
N14: the bench PC is not responding while its power is off; switch it on and sign in to it through the box

contents.name: Vault receipt

CAPTURE CARD (test)

Reading this records Lena's sign-in in the capture log. Her tile is then tagged Captured on a remote sign-in screen.

objects.name: Capture card: Ian
objects.observations: A test card for the capture log.
objects.text:
CAPTURE CARD (test)

Reading this records Ian's sign-in in the capture log. Lena's PC turns his account away: a wrong-account check.

objects.name: Sign: Start here
objects.text:
Twelve network beats. The comms room is north (P2, P10), the desk room east (P1, P9), the workshop west (P11).
The kiosk, the store and the finance office are off the desk room. Each beat has its own sign.
objects.observations: A sign on a stand by the front desk.

objects.name: Sign: P8 The vault
objects.text:
P8. The vault's code is on the door controller in the store, which has no screen.
Sign in to it from the box's view with Ian's details (they are in the finance archive), read Door codes, then open the vault.
objects.observations: A sign by the vault.

objects.name: Sign: P12 Reload
objects.text:
P12. With the box in the comms room and Lena signed in through it, reload the page.
The link item is still in your inventory, the port still looks planted, and Lena's desktop opens from the view with no password.
objects.observations: A sign by the door.

addCapture.note: Test capture for the remote sign-in tiles.
Test capture for the remote sign-in tiles (an account Lena's PC refuses).

objects.name: Spare wall port
objects.jackConfirm: Plug the drop box into this port?
objects.requiresItemHint: A spare network port. Something small could be plugged in here.
objects.observations: A spare network port on the wall, with a patch cable tucked beside it.

observationVariants.value: Your drop box is plugged in here, its light blinking.

objects.name: Sign: P2 Plant
objects.text:
P2. Before you take the box, the port says something small could go here. With the box, cancelling the confirm changes nothing.
Confirming plants it: the box leaves your inventory, a link item arrives, the port changes look and the view opens.
objects.observations: A sign by the wall port.

objects.name: Sign: P3 See
objects.text:
P3. The view lists four sign-in hosts (Sam's PC with Open, Lena's PC, the kiosk with remote sign-in off, the door controller), then an open share, a locked share and a printer.
Nothing from the workshop's network.
objects.observations: A sign by the wall port.

objects.name: Sign: P10 Unplug
objects.text:
P10. Click the port again: the box's network view opens, with Unplug under its title. Closing it with the X changes nothing.
Unplug gives the box back and ends the door controller's session. Lena's PC still opens at her desk. Plant again: the door controller asks for a password again.
objects.observations: A sign by the wall port.

objects.name: Locked switch port
objects.portSecurityMessage: The switch logs the device address and shuts the port. It only takes known machines; unused ports like this should be disabled.
objects.jackConfirm: Plug the drop box into this locked port?
objects.requiresItemHint: A second wall port. It looks locked down.
objects.observations: A second network port, with a switch label warning that the port is access controlled.

objects.name: Sign: N10 Port security
objects.text:
N10. Take the drop box and plug it into the locked switch port.
The box goes in, the switch refuses it and shuts the port: no link item, no view, and the box stays in your bag. The switch's message names the fix: disable unused ports.
objects.observations: A sign by the locked port.

objects.name: Server file host
objects.observations: A file host on the server network, managed by IT.

objects.name: Sign: N1 to N4 The pivot
objects.text:
The server network is linked to the office LAN, but the box's foothold does not reach it on its own (N1).
Sign in to an office PC through the box (Lena's), then the box's view gains a Server network block, through that PC (N2). Sign in to this host across the link with Ian's details (N3). Sign out of the office PC and this session ends with it (N4).
objects.observations: A sign by the server host.

objects.name: Server rack breaker
objects.observations: A breaker switch on the server rack. Flipping it takes the whole server network down.

triggerOnInteract.text: Flip the breaker? The whole server network goes down.

onConfirm.title: Server rack breaker
onConfirm.message: The breaker trips and the rack goes quiet. The server network is down.

triggerOnInteract.title: Server rack breaker
triggerOnInteract.message: The breaker is already off. The rack's power switch brings the server network back.

objects.name: Server rack power
objects.observations: The power switch that restores the server network after the breaker trips.
objects._comment: UX slice 15 R1 (m3, R4e): a named confirm, as every physical switch, only while the breaker has the rack off; with the rack on it says so.

triggerOnInteract.text: Switch the server rack back on?

onConfirm.title: Server rack power
onConfirm.message: The rack powers up. The server network is back.

objects.name: Sign: N5 to N7 Outages
objects.text:
Flip the rack breaker: the server network goes down, it leaves the box's view, and a sign-in on it is refused (N5). Flip the power back: its block fills in and its host signs in again (N6).
Sign in to this host first, then flip the breaker: your session is kept but shows no route; flip the power and its desktop opens again with no password (N7).
objects.observations: A sign by the server rack.

objects.name: Bench switch
objects.observations: A small switch on the workbench with a free port.

objects.name: Sign: P11 The other network
objects.text:

objects.observations: A sign by the bench.

tasks.title: P1: open the open share from Sam's desktop
P2: plant the box in the comms room
P3: look at what the box reaches
P4: copy the letter from the open share
P5: sign in to Lena's PC through the box, then open the locked folder
P6: Switch user on Lena's remote desktop is refused for Sam
P7: sign in at the kiosk itself
P8: open the lobby vault with the code from the store's door controller
P9: open Lena's PC at her desk
P10: unplug the box from the comms room
P11: plant the box in the workshop and look
P12: after a reload, Lena's PC opens through the box with no password
N11: a dropped stick an NPC uses gives a foothold on the door controller's network
N12: a BadUSB at Sam's desk gives a foothold and is consumed
N13: the kiosk's USB policy refuses the BadUSB
N8: join the guest Wi-Fi with the key and look at what it reaches
N9: join again through the second guest access point
N2: after signing in to an office PC through the box, the server network appears
N3: sign in to the server host across the link
N4: sign out of the office pivot and the server session ends
N10: a secured port refuses the box and keeps it
N5: take the server network down; it leaves the box's view and a sign-in on it is refused
N6: restore the server network; its block fills in and its host signs in again
N7: a held server session survives the outage, shows no route, and reopens on repair
N14: the bench PC is not responding while its power is off; switch it on and sign in to it through the box

objectives.title: Run the network beats
objectives.description: Test only. Each task ticks when its beat's event fires; the plant and the vault are checked by the server.

body.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model networks

A test floor for networks (ACCESS_MODEL_SLICE_9_3_PLAN.md, slice 9.3a). Twelve beats, each with a sign. Take the drop box from the lobby table and plug it into the wall port in the comms room (north): its link item in your inventory shows what that network exposes. Sam's PC is in the desk room (east), with the kiosk, the store and the finance office off it. The workshop (west) has a second port on a second network. Three people in the lobby hold the accounts.
